business_problem: ExpertSource needed to monitor far more call-center interactions for compliance because manual review of only a small sample left the company exposed to regulatory penalties, litigation and inconsistent service quality in debt-collection operations.
solution_summary: ExpertSource expanded its CXReview automated call-review platform through a co-creation project with IBM Client Engineering, turning keyword-based compliance monitoring into a cloud-native ML workflow. The solution runs in Kubernetes containers on Red Hat OpenShift and uses an embedded IBM service agreement to call IBM Watson Studio, IBM Watson Machine Learning, Speech to Text and Natural Language Understanding against recorded calls. Audio is transcribed, analyzed for natural-language meaning and checked against compliance requirements rather than simple keyword presence, allowing far broader monitoring coverage across the collections operation. Because the stack is deployable on public or private cloud, CXReview could keep evolving the platform while giving ExpertSource production-ready analytics in a short timeframe. The result is a scalable compliance pipeline that continuously evaluates calls, supports quality teams and reduces dependence on expensive manual sampling.

solution_components.name: IBM Watson Studio
solution_components.role: Supports the AI workflow used to build and refine automated call-review models.

solution_components.name: IBM Watson Machine Learning
solution_components.role: Runs machine-learning services that evaluate calls against compliance requirements.

solution_components.name: Speech to Text
solution_components.role: Transcribes recorded calls so downstream compliance models can analyze them.

solution_components.name: Natural Language Understanding
solution_components.role: Extracts meaning from call transcripts to detect compliance issues beyond simple keywords.

data_flow: Recorded calls are transcribed with Speech to Text, analyzed with Natural Language Understanding and Watson ML services, evaluated inside CXReview against compliance rules, and surfaced to quality teams through the OpenShift-hosted platform for broad, automated call monitoring.
business_outcome: ExpertSource expanded monitoring from a tiny sample to full coverage, improved collections performance, reduced legal risk and gave managers much more scalable visibility into agent compliance and service quality.
